supporting_quotes.exact: The order in which elements are added to or removed from a stack is described as last in, first out, referred to by the acronym LIFO.

observations.subject: the order in which elements are added to or removed from a stack
observations.object: last in, first out, referred to by the acronym LIFO

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-d286628a0b15 区间 [0,133] 完整陈述：元素加入/移除的次序被描述为 last in, first out，即缩写 LIFO；与 claim 的“后进先出（Last In, First Out，LIFO）”逐点一致，claim 未超出引文内容。

supporting_quotes.exact: As with a stack of physical objects, this structure makes it easy to take an item off the top of the stack, but accessing a datum deeper in the stack may require removing multiple other items first.

observations.subject: this structure (a stack)
observations.object: a stack of physical objects: easy to take an item off the top, but accessing a datum deeper may require removing multiple other items first

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-d10e607c26e6 区间 [0,198] 完整陈述：如实物堆叠，从栈顶取项容易，但访问栈中更深的数据（datum）可能需要先移除多个其他项；claim 的“访问栈中更深的元素可能需要先移除上面的多个元素”与“may require removing multiple other items first”一致，未超出引文。

supporting_quotes.exact: Additionally, a peek operation can, without modifying the stack, return the value of the last element added (the item at the top of the stack).

observations.subject: a peek operation
observations.predicate: can, without modifying the stack, return the value of
observations.object: the last element added (the item at the top of the stack)

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-4593be24621b 区间 [0,142] 完整陈述：peek 操作可在不修改栈的情况下返回最后加入元素（即栈顶项）的值；与 claim 的“不修改栈的情况下返回最后加入元素的值（栈顶项）”完全一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: Considered a sequential collection, a stack has one end which is the only position at which the push and pop operations may occur, the top of the stack, and is fixed at the other end, the bottom.

observations.subject: a stack (a sequential collection)
observations.object: one end (the top) as the only position for push and pop, and is fixed at the other end (the bottom)

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-13a035e39fcd 区间 [0,195] 完整陈述：栈被视为顺序集合（sequential collection），一端（top）是 push 与 pop 唯一可发生的位置，另一端（bottom）固定；与 claim 的“顺序集合、栈顶为唯一 push/pop 位置、栈底固定”一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: A stack may be implemented to have a bounded capacity. If the stack is full and does not contain enough space to accept another element, the stack is in a state of stack overflow.

observations.subject: a stack with bounded capacity
observations.object: stack overflow if full and without enough space for another element

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-4dc02e593e5a 区间 [0,179] 完整陈述：栈可实现为有界容量；若栈满且无足够空间接受另一个元素，即为 stack overflow 状态；与 claim 的“有界容量、栈已满且无足够空间则处于栈溢出状态”一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: A stack can be easily implemented either through an array or a linked list, as it is merely a special case of a list. In either case, what identifies the data structure as a stack is not the implementation but the interface: the user is only allowed to pop or push items onto the array or linked list, with few other helper operations.
A stack may be implemented as, for example, a singly linked list with a pointer to the top element.

observations.subject: a stack
observations.object: an array or linked list (a special case of a list); it is identified not by implementation but by the interface (only pop/push allowed)

observations.subject: a stack
observations.object: a singly linked list with a pointer to the top element

claims.rationale: 引文1 evidence-322b64c2a9f2 区间 [0,335] 覆盖：可用数组或链表实现、是 list 的特例、标识为栈的是接口而非实现、用户只被允许 pop/push；引文2 evidence-78c22ee5ee5f 区间 [0,99] 覆盖：可用指向栈顶元素的单链表实现。两引文共同逐点支撑 claim 的全部分句，无冲突、无超出。

supporting_quotes.exact: The push operation adds an element and increments the top index, after checking for overflow:
Similarly, pop decrements the top index after checking for underflow, and returns the item that was previously the top one:

observations.subject: the push operation
observations.object: the top index, after checking for overflow

observations.subject: the pop operation
observations.predicate: decrements the top index after checking for underflow, and returns
observations.object: the item that was previously the top one

claims.rationale: 引文1 evidence-1fae9bf0b3f4 区间 [0,93] 陈述 push 在检查溢出后添加元素并递增 top 索引；引文2 evidence-57bb10891387 区间 [0,123] 陈述 pop 在检查下溢后递减 top 索引并返回原先的栈顶项；与 claim 的 push/pop 语义描述完全一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: Calculators that employ reverse Polish notation use a stack structure to hold values. Expressions can be represented in prefix, postfix or infix notations and conversion from one form to another may be accomplished using a stack. Many compilers use a stack to parse syntax before translation into low-level code.

observations.subject: stacks
observations.object: RPN calculators (to hold values), conversions among prefix/postfix/infix notations, and many compilers (to parse syntax before low-level translation)

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-63eafcee671c 区间 [0,312] 分三句完整覆盖 claim 的三部分：RPN 计算器用栈保存值；表达式可用 prefix/postfix/infix 表示且相互转换可用栈完成；许多编译器在翻译为低级代码前用栈解析语法。逐点一致。

supporting_quotes.exact: Another important application of stacks is backtracking.
This can be achieved through the use of stacks, as a last correct point can be pushed onto the stack, and popped from the stack in case of an incorrect path.

observations.subject: backtracking (this)
observations.object: pushing a last correct point onto the stack and popping it in case of an incorrect path

claims.rationale: 引文1 evidence-4fe264776635 区间 [0,56] 声明回溯是栈的另一个重要应用；引文2 evidence-a7ae1699eb8d 区间 [0,157] 中的 “This” 指代前文的 backtracking，陈述可将最后正确点压入栈、在错误路径时弹出。两引文衔接紧密，共同支撑 claim 的“回溯应用+压入最后正确点/错误路径时弹出”，无冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: There is also a number of small microprocessors that implement a stack directly in hardware, and some microcontrollers have a fixed-depth stack that is not directly accessible.

observations.subject: small microprocessors / some microcontrollers
observations.object: a stack directly in hardware; a fixed-depth stack that is not directly accessible

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-def936ce83dc 区间 [0,175] 完整陈述：若干小型微处理器直接在硬件中实现栈，部分微控制器具有不可直接访问的定深栈；与 claim 的“不少小型微处理器硬件实现栈、一些微控制器有不可直接访问的定深栈”一致。
